photos.c: Left: It's November 26th 1977 at Parliament Hill and showing no fear, eighteen year-old Dave Beaver (253), racing in the classic Polytechnic Harriers singlet, locks horns with "Bootsie" Dave Bedford (284) in the London Cross Country Championships. Bedford won with Dave 4th and Bob Treadwell (329 in the photo) 2nd.
